provider_credentials_envelope_valid.name: provider_credentials_envelope_valid
provider_credentials_envelope_valid.value:
"provider_credentials"."version" = 1
    and char_length("provider_credentials"."key_id") between 1 and 64 and "provider_credentials"."key_id" collate "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    and "provider_credentials"."nonce" collate "C" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{24}$'
    and "provider_credentials"."auth_tag" collate "C" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$'
    and char_length("provider_credentials"."ciphertext") between 2 and 8192 and "provider_credentials"."ciphertext" collate "C" ~ '^([a-f0-9]{2})+$'

game_slots_scope_check.name: game_slots_scope_check
game_slots_scope_check.value: "game_slots"."scope" in ('ordinary', 'sandbox') and ("game_slots"."scope" = 'ordinary' or "game_slots"."guest_session_id" is not null)

game_participants_identity_check.name: game_participants_identity_check
game_participants_identity_check.value:
num_nonnulls("game_participants"."guest_session_id", "game_participants"."user_id") <= 1
        and ("game_participants"."seat_type" = 'human' or ("game_participants"."guest_session_id" is null and "game_participants"."user_id" is null))

game_participants_configuration_check.name: game_participants_configuration_check
game_participants_configuration_check.value:
("game_participants"."seat_type" = 'human' and "game_participants"."provider" is null
        and "game_participants"."model_id" is null and "game_participants"."parameters" is null)
      or ("game_participants"."seat_type" = 'ai' and "game_participants"."provider" is not null
        and "game_participants"."model_id" is not null and "game_participants"."parameters" is not null)

game_participants_model_id_check.name: game_participants_model_id_check
game_participants_model_id_check.value:
"game_participants"."model_id" is null or (length("game_participants"."model_id") between 1 and 256
        and "game_participants"."model_id" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._:/@+-]*$')

game_participants_parameters_check.name: game_participants_parameters_check
game_participants_parameters_check.value:
"game_participants"."parameters" is null or (
        jsonb_typeof("game_participants"."parameters") = 'object'
        and octet_length("game_participants"."parameters"::text) <= 512
        and "game_participants"."parameters" - array['temperature', 'reasoningEffort', 'maxOutputTokens'] = '{}'::jsonb
        and (not ("game_participants"."parameters" ? 'temperature') or case
          when jsonb_typeof("game_participants"."parameters"->'temperature') = 'number'
          then ("game_participants"."parameters"->>'temperature')::numeric between 0 and 9007199254740991
          else false end)
        and (not ("game_participants"."parameters" ? 'reasoningEffort') or (
          jsonb_typeof("game_participants"."parameters"->'reasoningEffort') = 'string'
          and length("game_participants"."parameters"->>'reasoningEffort') between 1 and 64
          and "game_participants"."parameters"->>'reasoningEffort' ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$'))
        and (not ("game_participants"."parameters" ? 'maxOutputTokens') or case
          when jsonb_typeof("game_participants"."parameters"->'maxOutputTokens') = 'number'
          then ("game_participants"."parameters"->>'maxOutputTokens')::numeric between 1 and 9007199254740991
            and mod(("game_participants"."parameters"->>'maxOutputTokens')::numeric, 1) = 0
          else false end)
      )

games_account_history_idx.name: games_account_history_idx
games_account_history_idx.where: "games"."state" in ('completed', 'aborted') and not "games"."is_sandbox" and "games"."mode" is not null

games_owner_check.name: games_owner_check
games_owner_check.value:
case when "games"."mode"::text = 'human_vs_human'
        then "games"."owner_guest_session_id" is null
          and ("games"."owner_user_id" is not null or "games"."state" in ('completed', 'aborted'))
        else num_nonnulls("games"."owner_guest_session_id", "games"."owner_user_id") = 1 end

games_lifecycle_check.name: games_lifecycle_check
games_lifecycle_check.value:
("games"."state" in ('configuring', 'active', 'paused') and "games"."result" = '*' and "games"."termination_reason" is null)
    or ("games"."state" = 'completed' and "games"."result" in ('1-0', '0-1') and "games"."termination_reason" is not null
      and "games"."termination_reason" in ('checkmate', 'human_resignation', 'model_technical_loss'))
    or ("games"."state" = 'completed' and "games"."result" = '1/2-1/2' and "games"."termination_reason" is not null
      and "games"."termination_reason" in ('stalemate', 'insufficient_material', 'threefold_repetition', 'fifty_move_rule'))
    or ("games"."state" = 'aborted' and "games"."result" = '*' and "games"."termination_reason" is not null
      and "games"."termination_reason" = 'aborted')

model_invocations_error_check.name: model_invocations_error_check
model_invocations_error_check.value:
(("model_invocations"."error_code" is null and "model_invocations"."error_reason" is null)
      or ("model_invocations"."error_code" = 'model_invalid' and "model_invocations"."error_reason" is not null and "model_invocations"."error_reason" in ('malformed_output', 'illegal_move', 'refusal', 'truncated_output'))
      or ("model_invocations"."error_code" in ('provider_auth', 'provider_quota', 'provider_timeout') and "model_invocations"."error_reason" is null)
      or ("model_invocations"."error_code" = 'provider_unavailable' and "model_invocations"."error_reason" is not null and "model_invocations"."error_reason" in ('network', 'upstream', 'invalid_response', 'unsupported_model', 'cancelled'))) is true

model_invocations_result_check.name: model_invocations_result_check
model_invocations_result_check.value:
("model_invocations"."outcome" in ('in_flight', 'interrupted') and "model_invocations"."error_code" is null and "model_invocations"."duration_ms" is null and not "model_invocations"."usage_reported" and "model_invocations"."commentary" is null)
      or ("model_invocations"."duration_ms" is not null and (
        ("model_invocations"."outcome" = 'accepted' and "model_invocations"."error_code" is null)
        or ("model_invocations"."commentary" is null and (
          ("model_invocations"."outcome" = 'model_invalid' and "model_invocations"."error_code" is not null and "model_invocations"."error_code" = 'model_invalid')
          or ("model_invocations"."outcome" = 'provider_error' and "model_invocations"."error_code" is not null and "model_invocations"."error_code" <> 'model_invalid')
          or "model_invocations"."outcome" = 'discarded'))))

model_invocations_usage_check.name: model_invocations_usage_check
model_invocations_usage_check.value:
("model_invocations"."usage_reported" or ("model_invocations"."input_tokens" is null and "model_invocations"."output_tokens" is null and "model_invocations"."total_tokens" is null))
      and ("model_invocations"."duration_ms" is null or "model_invocations"."duration_ms" between 0 and 9007199254740991)
      and ("model_invocations"."input_tokens" is null or "model_invocations"."input_tokens" between 0 and 9007199254740991)
      and ("model_invocations"."output_tokens" is null or "model_invocations"."output_tokens" between 0 and 9007199254740991)
      and ("model_invocations"."total_tokens" is null or "model_invocations"."total_tokens" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

model_invocations_parameters_check.name: model_invocations_parameters_check
model_invocations_parameters_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("model_invocations"."effective_parameters") = 'object'
      and octet_length("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"::text) <= 512
      and "model_invocations"."effective_parameters" - array['temperature', 'reasoningEffort', 'maxOutputTokens'] = '{}'::jsonb
      and (not ("model_invocations"."effective_parameters" ? 'temperature') or case
        when jsonb_typeof("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->'temperature') = 'number'
        then ("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->>'temperature')::numeric between 0 and 9007199254740991 else false end)
      and (not ("model_invocations"."effective_parameters" ? 'reasoningEffort') or (
        jsonb_typeof("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->'reasoningEffort') = 'string'
        and length("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->>'reasoningEffort') between 1 and 64
        and "model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->>'reasoningEffort' ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$'))
      and (not ("model_invocations"."effective_parameters" ? 'maxOutputTokens') or case
        when jsonb_typeof("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->'maxOutputTokens') = 'number'
        then ("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->>'maxOutputTokens')::numeric between 1 and 9007199254740991
          and mod(("model_invocations"."effective_parameters"->>'maxOutputTokens')::numeric, 1) = 0 else false end)

moves_uci_check.name: moves_uci_check
moves_uci_check.value:
"moves"."uci" ~ '^[a-h][1-8][a-h][1-8][qrbn]?$'
    and length("moves"."uci") in (4, 5) and left("moves"."uci", 2) <> substring("moves"."uci" from 3 for 2)

profiles_username_valid.name: profiles_username_valid
profiles_username_valid.value:
("profiles"."username" is null and "profiles"."username_normalized" is null) or
    ("profiles"."username" is not null and "profiles"."username_normalized" is not null
      and "profiles"."username" collate "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,24}$'
      and "profiles"."username_normalized" = lower("profiles"."username" collate "C")
      and "profiles"."username_normalized" not in (
        'admin', 'administrator', 'api', 'arena', 'auth', 'guest', 'help', 'login',
        'logout', 'moderator', 'neurochess', 'root', 'security', 'support', 'system', 'www'
      ))

room_creation_operations_state_check.name: room_creation_operations_state_check
room_creation_operations_state_check.value:
("room_creation_operations"."state" = 'pending' and "room_creation_operations"."owner_color" is null and "room_creation_operations"."game_id" is null)
    or ("room_creation_operations"."state" = 'consumed' and "room_creation_operations"."owner_color" is not null)

rooms_join_receipt_check.name: rooms_join_receipt_check
rooms_join_receipt_check.value:
("rooms"."join_command_id" is null and "rooms"."joined_invitation_digest" is null)
      or ("rooms"."state" = 'joined' and "rooms"."join_command_id" is not null
        and "rooms"."joined_invitation_digest" is not null and "rooms"."joined_invitation_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

rooms_admission_check.name: rooms_admission_check
rooms_admission_check.value:
("rooms"."state" = 'waiting' and "rooms"."joined_at" is null)
    or ("rooms"."state" = 'joined' and "rooms"."joined_at" is not null and "rooms"."invitation_digest" is null)
